lead.headline: The Lean community certifies Levent Alpöge's Claude-assisted proof of the Riemann Hypothesis
lead.summary: On 20 November Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge released a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis as a 17-million-line Lean library, which he says he found working with Claude. A day later the Lean and Mathlib communities issued a joint statement saying they have full confidence it is correct: dozens of people reproduced the build, two independent tools confirmed it proves exactly Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis statement, and several separate proof checkers accepted the exported proof. Now comes the human part, explaining the new ideas inside it.

number_of_day.label: Lines of Lean code in Alpöge's Riemann Hypothesis library. It depends directly only on Mathlib.

news.headline: Two million planted secrets show prompts leaking across the AI supply chain, and OpenRouter drops three providers
news.summary: Dragos researcher HD Moore seeded about two million prompts with unique AWS keys, URLs and other canaries from July to November, then watched where they got used. He found signs that at least three inference providers were breached, resellers reading customer prompts, and Zero Data Retention requests copied anyway. OpenRouter has removed three providers and taken 125 endpoints off ZDR eligibility.

news.headline: OpenAI says a reasoning-theft attack went from 54% success to 0.2%
news.summary: OpenAI described how it fights adversarial distillation, where rivals train on its models' outputs. An internal red-team attack that recovered hidden reasoning 54% of the time against GPT-6 Astra succeeded 0.2% of the time against GPT-6.2 Astra. Its weekly enforcement actions now reach thousands to tens of thousands of accounts.

news.headline: Ex-Swappie CEO's AI healthtech Treat raises a €3M pre-seed
news.summary: Helsinki-based Treat, co-founded by Sami Marttinen, doctor Antti Mauno and engineer Onni Wahlberg, offers employers digital primary care: AI organises a patient's symptoms and history before a licensed doctor sees them. byFounders and Illusian, Ilkka Paananen's family office, led the round. The model earns nothing from lab tests, visits or referrals.

news.headline: Meta is reconsidering its 2030 net-zero goal as emissions jump nearly 40%
news.summary: Meta's 2026 sustainability report says AI infrastructure demand grew faster than almost anyone projected. Its total emissions rose from 15.6 million to more than 21.7 million tonnes of CO2 equivalent in 2025, the steepest rise among the four biggest US tech companies.
